subject: Mutual action & close timeline: POC environment readiness for Medicore Labs
messages:
From: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@medicorelabs.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sam Ellis <sam.ellis@medicorelabs.com>
Date: 2028-02-20T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: POC readiness & MAP items — Medicore Labs

Hi Neha,

Thanks for the call earlier. We're excited to run the POC with Redwood. To align expectations and hit our end-of-quarter close, we sketched a short mutual action plan and a target timeline. Key items we need from Redwood to validate performance:

- Org setup for our team (tenant/org creation + initial admin users)
- API keys for the evaluation (ephemeral keys preferred; rotation guidance)
- IP allowlist entries for your endpoints (we'll add the CIDRs)
- VPC peering guidance and diagram for our cloud team to review

High-level target: provision environment and run initial 48-hour perf tests by 2028-03-01. Procurement will need an SOW + estimate for credits. I attached our internal MAP worksheet for your reference.

Can you confirm owners and a proposed ship-by date for each item?

Thanks,
Alex Morgan
Head of ML Ops, Medicore Labs

Attachments: Medicore_MAP_v1.xlsx
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@medicorelabs.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-02-20T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC readiness & MAP items — Medicore Labs

Alex — thanks for the clear list and the MAP worksheet. We're aligned on scope. Owners and initial slate below:

- Org setup (Redwood): Neha — will create tenant and provision admin roles by 2028-02-22.
- API keys (Evaluation): Jordan — will issue scoped, time-limited keys and provide rotation instructions by 2028-02-24.
- IP allowlist: Engineering (Sooj) — we can accept CIDRs; please provide the public NAT ranges you intend to use. We'll whitelist within 24 hours of receipt.
- VPC peering: Platform Eng (Jordan) — will review Medicore CIDR, share peering diagram and required peering ACLs by 2028-02-25.

I've attached a Redwood-side MAP draft (minor edits to your sheet) and a high-level peering diagram placeholder. Procurement note: we can produce an SOW and credit estimate once procurement contact confirms billing entity and PO process.

Next steps: can you loop in procurement contact and your infra lead's preferred CIDRs? If Medicore wants ephemeral API keys for the evaluation, Jordan will outline TTL and rotation patterns in his follow-up.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference

Attachments: Medicore_MAP_v1_RedwoodEdits.xlsx, VPC_Peering_Diagram.png
From: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@medicorelabs.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sam Ellis <sam.ellis@medicorelabs.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@medicorelabs.com>
Date: 2028-02-21T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC readiness & MAP items — Medicore Labs

Thanks Neha — cc'ing procurement and our infra lead Sam. A few notes and answers:

- Procurement: procurement@medicorelabs.com is the right contact; they require an SOW and an estimate; DocuSign is acceptable.
- Infra/CIDRs: our egress NAT ranges are 34.217.128.0/20 and 52.12.0.0/20 (AWS us-east-1). We can create a dedicated VPC for peering; CIDR will be 10.40.0.0/16.
- Ephemeral keys: yes, ephemeral keys are preferred for the evaluation; we'd target 12-hour TTL with rolling rotation.

Attached is an internal network readiness checklist — should help Jordan/Sooj debug quick. We'll aim to have the peering request submitted by 2028-02-23.

Alex

Attachments: medicore_network_readiness.xlsx

On Tue, Feb 20, 2028 at 11:02 AM Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Alex — thanks for the clear list and the MAP worksheet. We're aligned on scope....
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@medicorelabs.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-02-23T14:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC readiness & MAP items — Medicore Labs

Alex / Sam / Procurement — great, thanks for the CIDRs and procurement contact. Quick operational plan and commitments from Redwood:

1) Org setup
- Action: create Medicore tenant, add Alex + Sam as admins, enable audit logging.
- Owner: Neha.
- Commit: tenant + admin users live by 2028-02-22 18:00 PT (DONE).

2) API keys (evaluation)
- Action: issue scoped, ephemeral API keys (12h TTL) with example curl and SDK snippets; provide rotation script sample.
- Owner: Jordan.
- Commit: keys & docs published by 2028-02-24 12:00 PT.
- Note: keys will be limited to the evaluation model family and token quota we discussed. If you need higher token limits, we'll need a quick quota request.

3) IP allowlist
- Action: we'll whitelist your egress ranges 34.217.128.0/20 and 52.12.0.0/20 for the evaluation endpoint and peering control plane.
- Owner: Soojin.
- Commit: allowlist in place within 24 hours of this email (expected 2028-02-24 14:00 PT).

4) VPC peering
- Action: Jordan will share a minimal peering checklist (routing, security groups, required ports) and a DocuSign-ready peering addendum.
- Owner: Jordan.
- Commit: peering checklist and peering diagram sent by 2028-02-25; we expect Medicore to submit a peering request the same day to your cloud team.

5) Timeline & acceptance criteria
- Target: initial perf run (48-hour) window starting 2028-03-01.
- Acceptance: Redwood confirms latency P95 below 350ms for the test workload and endpoint authorization successful using ephemeral keys.

Attachments we uploaded to the shared Drive for your traceability: MAP with owners (Medicore_MAP_v1_RedwoodEdits.xlsx), VPC peering diagram, SOC2 summary. DocuSign SOW link will be sent to procurement within 24 hours.

Please confirm: (a) procurement accepts DocuSign, (b) Sam will submit the peering request by 2028-02-25 EOD, and (c) whether you want a canary traffic window before the 48-hour perf run.

If all confirmed, we will lock the MAP and start the onboarding checklist.

Regards,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 415-555-0192

---
